lore.arena: This isn't a to-do list. It's an arena.
lore.reglas: Every day you have missions. Completing them earns XP and raises your level; failing them takes it away. Your streak multiplies. Big projects are campaigns with a final boss. And there's a coach who sets your day, reminds you at night what's at stake and remembers everything it learns about you.
lore.trampas: No cheating: proof is taken with the camera, in the moment. The system has no opinions. It logs.

nombre.codigoAyuda: If someone recommended it, enter their code. It changes nothing for you.
nombre.codigoA11y: Code of the creator who brought you, optional
nombre.codigoRechazado: {{motivo}} Fix it or continue without it.

camino.titulo: What will you use NIVL for?
camino.pista: It changes what you see first and what the coach asks of you. Everything stays available and you can change it in Profile.

objetivo.pista: One thing, in one sentence. Not “get better”: what you want to have achieved. It's what you're going to sign.
objetivo.salud: My goal includes health or training
objetivo.sinSalud: Write a general goal, with no health data. To include it, turn on the option above.

misiones.pista: Suggested for your profile ({{para}}). Remove the ones that don't fit you; you can create your own in Habits.

firma.pista: It's sealed today and opens when the time is up. Your coach can read it to help you. Choose how long you give yourself.
firma.letraPequena: Until then, Contract keeps it sealed. You'll write your rules and their consequences there once you're in.

coach.titulo: Your plan is ready. Choose how to continue.
coach.pista: NIVL and your habits stay free. Each paid mode opens its world and its coach.
coach.pistaHoja: NIVL and your habits stay free. Each paid mode opens its world and its coach.

sello.a11y: Sealed. Expires on {{fecha}}. Tap to continue

idioma.pista: It comes from your phone's language. You can change it later in Profile.

compromiso.firma: I, {{nombre}}, sign this commitment with myself on {{firmadoEl}}, the day I joined NIVL.
compromiso.promesa: I don't promise perfect days. I promise to be 1% better every day: a mission done when I don't feel like it, a rule kept when nobody is watching, an honest log when the day has gone badly.
compromiso.unoPorCiento: 1% doesn't show in a week. In {{plazo}} it's another life.
compromiso.fallo: When I fail, I won't negotiate with the system. I'll accept the penalty, carry out the consequence and come back the next day.
compromiso.apertura: To whoever opens this on {{seAbreEl}}: you are what I did with each of these days. I hope I lived up to you.

portada.lema: Your best self already has a coach
portada.texto: Training, study, work and business. A coach who tells you what to do today and won't let you slip away.

mejora.t: What do you want to improve?
mejora.p: Pick everything that matters to you.

kind.p: Your app arranges itself around this.

meta.t: What do you want to achieve?
meta.p: The thing that would truly make you proud.

cuanto.t: How long have you wanted this?
cuanto.p: Be honest. Your coach uses this to adjust your plan.

freno.t: What's held you back so far?

coach.t: Have you ever had a coach or trainer?
coach.p: It changes how I'll work with you.

o.caro: I thought about it, but it's expensive

min.t: How much time can you give it each day?

mom.t: When are you at your best?
mom.p: That's where I'll put the hardest part.

deportista.carrera: Train for a triathlon or a race

trabajador.rendir: Get more done in fewer hours
trabajador.vida: Get my life outside work back

emprendedor.lanzarme: Quit my job and go for it

crudo.titulo: I'm going to be blunt with you.
crudo.cuerpo: I'm not here to be liked. I'm here so that 90 days from now you're not the same person.
crudo.detalle: I'll tell you when you're lying to yourself. I'll call it out when you try to dodge. And I'll be with you every time you deliver.
crudo.pregunta: How do you want me to talk to you?
crudo.duro: No filter. Give it to me straight

curva.titulo: 1% a day doesn't look like much.
curva.cuerpo: It's math, not a promise. The hard part is not missing a day. That's what I'm for.
curva.a11y: Rising curve: up 35 percent in 30 days, up 145 percent in 90 days

cuenta.titulo: Your plan is almost ready. Save it.
cuenta.texto: So you lose nothing, on your phone or your computer.

bienvenida.titulo: A couple of things and we start.
bienvenida.texto: Your plan is already underway. Before you save it, you need to know this:

salud.titulo: Your health data, only with your permission.
salud.texto: To prepare workouts, meals and rest I need to store health data. It's your call, and you can withdraw it whenever you want in Profile.
salud.sinPermiso: Without permission, your plan loses the health goal and those missions. Everything else works the same.

veredicto.duro: {{cuanto}} wanting this and your excuse is “{{freno}}”. You've got {{min}} a day. That's enough. What isn't enough is waiting any longer.
veredicto.tacto: {{cuanto}} wanting it. It's normal to get stuck on “{{freno}}”. With {{min}} a day you'll get there, and I'll take you.

sem4.detalle: Now you have something to compare against.

dia90.detalle: You measure what you achieved against your goal.

sem4.detalle: Reviews at just the right moment.

dia90.detalle: You know what you've mastered and what's left for the exam.

hoy.detalle: What moves your week the most.
What brings in money comes first.

sem4.detalle: You know what works and what doesn't.

dia90.detalle: You look back with data, not memory.

tarjetas.avisosTexto: I'll remind you of your mission and the day's close. Change it whenever you want in Profile.
tarjetas.firmaTexto: You've already started. Now put it in writing: a letter to yourself that opens a few years from now.
